title: Monica De La Cruz
intro:
Monica De La Cruz (Republican Party) is a member of the U.S. House, representing Texas' 15th Congressional District. She assumed office on January 3, 2023. Her current term ends on January 3, 2027.
De La Cruz (Republican Party) is running for re-election to the U.S. House to represent Texas' 15th Congressional District. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. She advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
